text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. This Machan doll has something
to say to
you today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Hello there. It's time for health class with me, the Machan doll! Today's class is... The Dangers of Working Too Hard!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Overworking increases your risk of
injury and
losing motivation as well, so
remember to take it
easy."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm. I'd better be careful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...It seems like Aston Machan is pretty
tired from
her races. I should probably
readjust her
schedule.
